column11: Started OCR in 22, after moving to the States. Since then I've been challenging myself to the hardest events I can attend. I've completed over 100 races, including numerous Ultrafecta weekends and "Quadfecta" weekends (ultra, beast, super and sprint). I'm one of the only three people ever completing a Hurricane heat trifecta (4, 12 & 24 hrs) and OCR trifecta (Beast, Super and sprint) on the same weekend (Misano 2024). I'm also a Summer Death Race finisher among many other accolades.  In 2024 I went to Florida only having done only one prior TM (a 15k earlier that year) to run with a group, helping someone to reach her goal mileage. When the sun rose the next day, she was just one lap to get her goal, so I decided to go by myself the last 5 hrs and completed 75 mi. It was one of the hardest things I had ever done and I knew I wanted to go back and try by myself, at my own pace. This year I've left aside many of my usual races and podium chasing to focus on training for WTM, with the big scary goal of getting to 100 mi. I know I can do it, but I also know that it will take all of me.
